reason: Publish v3.6.1 so the injected gates carry #252: the four gates with a concurrency group (lint-format, secret-scan, pr-title, typecheck-ts) now key it on github.workflow_sha as well as workflow name and PR ref. Gate Family surface of this transition is exactly that one commit (ae45de1): audit.yml is byte-identical at d36c6f4 and cc4ed87, and the other four differ only in their concurrency group and its comment. Why: a Candidate Validation injects the same file a second time from an evaluate-mode ruleset at the candidate commit; with the old key both injections shared one group and cancel-in-progress killed whichever registered first, at random (v3.6.0 publication, #251: the candidate survived 1 of 4 first attempts, and reruns re-resolve to the live tag so only fresh events could produce evidence). With the SHA in the key a newer commit on the same PR still supersedes an in-flight run of the same version, while different versions coexist. Candidate Validation per the runbook: .github-private#249 added evaluate-mode duplicates of all four families at refs/tags/v3.6.1; forced pull_request events on four repos (claude-workflows#116, aw-gateway#50, claude-lsps#159, todoist-classify#260) produced 14 family-pairs = 28 runs, every one completed successfully and none cancelled - at the v3.6.0 validation exactly one run of every pair was cancelled. Runs: claude-workflows lint-format 33667930031/33667929871, pr-title 33667929889/33667929869, secret-scan 33667929897/33667929817, typecheck-ts 33667929893/33667929892; todoist-classify lint-format 33667953075/33667952931, typecheck-ts 33667953035/33667953004; aw-gateway lint-format 33667938266/33667938331; claude-lsps secret-scan 33667945234/33667945248. The duplicates are removed in a follow-up .github-private PR once this publishes.
